name: Ballroom
_notes: Ballroom - an open-roof hexagonal gallery in deathball's flat pit bowl (~165x135m flat at x235-400 z585-720, terrain 3.4-7.2m across the footprint). Six 33.5m walls (3.5m tall, vaultable) in a hexagon ring (R32, ~55m across) - each wall's y is seated on ITS terrain sample (base sunk ~0.75m, seatKits min-sample rule) so no face buries: tops run y6.6-10. Invisible ballOnly 'hull' fences continue each wall to ~y38 - open sky, no ceiling; a ball launched over the fences leaves cleanly and the leash snaps it back, never a phantom bounce. NO floor slab - the bowl terrain is the floor. ballMix forces variant-0 (smallest, r1.2) even hosted; max12 caps the ambient trickle via spec. balls.zone: spawn inside r18, pursuit aims at the room center, leash 30 snaps tunneled balls back inside the 32m corner (fences cover every face). Spawn eye y8 drops ~1m. Solo entry: OFFLINE > BALLS > BALLROOM, or deep link /?mode=classic&map=ballroom. Classic mode forces variant-0 balls so ballMix is host-only.
